item.title: Seisai no Resonance
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Yatagarasu
  • 発売日: 2013-02-22
  • スコア: 7.279999999999999/10 (213 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 星彩のレゾナンス
  • 英語名: Seisai no Resonance

别名

  • Resonance of the Starlight

あらすじ

Otofuse Island is a remote island located south of the mainland. While it is a beautiful sightseeing place surrounded by clear seas and lush forests, it is also bound by tradition. A long time ago, a giant fireball came down from the sky, burning the island for three whole days. Since the men were out fishing, it was up to the women to control the flames and protect the island. They sealed the fire so that it would not ravage the island again. Even now, a sealing ritual is performed by a selected pair of mikos.

item.title: Tentacle Lord -Waga Te ni Ochiyo Yuusou Naru Otome-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Yatagarasu
  • 発売日: 2011-11-25
  • スコア: 6.859999999999999/10 (64 人評価)
  • 日本語名: テンタクルロード －我が手に堕ちよ勇壮なる乙女－
  • 英語名: Tentacle Lord -Waga Te ni Ochiyo Yuusou Naru Otome-

あらすじ

On the continent of Septentrio, there are tales of the past when heroes and demon lords fought against each other. There was a maou that ruled over the fertile Kingdom of Grüngard. The imperial family was quite adept at magic and lived much longer than humans. The neighbouring countries feared history repeating itself and attacked, but they were always defeated. Now the kingdom is ruled by the young but skilled Dune Angrojia Grüngard, who is well respected by his people. He has the special ability of being able to control tentacled creatures to defeat enemies. Due to an unfortunate accident, he was put into a deep sleep for many years. During this time, the Kingdom of Rindveld which is full of heroes declared war on Grüngard with the intention of defeating him. When Dune awoke, the attacking forces led by Aria Ashtein had already reached the city limits. He decides to unleash his tentacled minions to defeat them and reclaim his territory.

item.title: Yamiyo ni Odore -Witch Wishes to Commit the Night-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Yatagarasu
  • 発売日: 2011-05-27
  • スコア: 7.109999999999999/10 (80 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 闇夜に踊れ -Witch wishes to commit the Night-
  • 英語名: Yamiyo ni Odore -Witch Wishes to Commit the Night-

あらすじ

Witches and magicians have always been fighting each other since the beginning of time. It’s not because one is bad or good, but because their powers keeps the world in balance. So, in a time continuum separated from the world, they continue their long battle. Note that you can choose to be a male or female protagonist.

item.title: Kokoro no Sumika
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Yatagarasu
  • 発売日: 2010-04-23
  • スコア: 6.609999999999999/10 (30 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ココロの住処
  • 英語名: Kokoro no Sumika

别名

  • A Home of Kokoro

あらすじ

This is Yatagarasu’s debut work. Chihiro likes his imouto Rina, but she doesn’t want him around. In fact, Rina loves her older sister Matsuri, who in turns likes Chihiro! In the midst of this (taboo?) love triangle, their scientist parents sent them some packages and Chihiro opened them and found some weird stuff. His father returns shortly after with a strange girl and introduces her as an android named Kokoro.
